Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Brooklyn College is part of the State University of New York (SUNY) in its final decision (Step 10), directly contradicting the explicit evidence gathered in previous steps (Steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9) which consistently identified Brooklyn College as part of the City University of New York (CUNY). The official CUNY website and multiple search results explicitly stated "Brooklyn College is part of the City University of New York system" and "senior college of the City University of New York." The Planner failed to synthesize the correct information from the authoritative sources it had already accessed and instead hallucinated an affiliation with SUNY, likely due to a confusion between the two major New York state university systems.
